zh: 组件可以调 `widget.notify({ title, body })` 发起通知：侧栏的看板入口右上角滑入未读条数，悬停读到最近一条的标题与正文，点一下看板入口之后清零；番茄钟到点会自己发一条。
en: Widgets can call `widget.notify({ title, body })` to raise a notification: the Board entry in the sidebar slides in the unread count, hovering reads the latest title and body, clicking the entry clears it, and the pomodoro raises one when its session ends.
